head_note: Neural-gaps lane N3 (2026-10-09): LayerNorm device I/O for the class (default ON, env before arm), kept forward stats (default ON, env before arm), and the IDENTICAL 32-lane row fold (default OFF, bits change, the gridded switch)

ln_row_warp.note: IDENTICAL only. The LayerNorm forward (sum x, sum (x - mean)^2) and backward-x (sum g, sum g xhat) row reductions as fold32's 32-slot order: logical lane j folds c = j, j + 32, ... ascending from +0.0, then the five-level pairwise tree (tree32). Device: the coop warp cell (coop_ln_fwd_rw / coop_ln_bwd_x_rw, shuffle_xor strides 16..1, inside a 32-lane half on CDNA); one-thread op and host twin: the same slots and tree32. BITS CHANGE against main's one-chain row on NVIDIA, AMD and host together; dweight / dbias folds unchanged. Cost: the one-chain row is D dependent adds per reduction (latency-bound at any D >= 32); the fold is D/32 + 5. ID check nv/amd owed before the A/B. Reaches neural:layernorm (and any LayerNorm user).

ln_class_device_io_off.note: Python-shell ENVIRONMENT switch, not a build define (the planner's define arms do not reach it; A/B by ENV=MOJOLEARN_LN_CLASS_DEVICE_IO_OFF=1 on the race line). Default ON (absent): mojolearn.LayerNorm reports _device_io and has to_device, so the board's generic layer path (and any caller who uploads x once) takes the resident entry layer_norm_dev: no x upload, y download, x + dy upload, dx download inside the clock (4 x M x D floats per fit) and no page-faulted zero fills. Same launches on the same values: no bits. MOJOLEARN_SEQ_DEVICE_IO_OFF=1 and MOJOLEARN_IDN_ALL_OFF=1 also turn it off.

ln_keep_stats_off.note: Python-shell ENVIRONMENT switch (A/B by ENV=MOJOLEARN_LN_KEEP_STATS_OFF=1 on the race line). Default ON (absent): a resident LayerNorm.forward stores its row mean / rstd in two kept M-float resident tensors and backward passes them (6-handle layer_norm_dev, ip[5] = 1), so the device entry skips the forward recompute: one OP_LN_FWD launch over M x D and an M x D scratch y fewer per backward. The stats are the forward's own stores: no bits. Only reached with the class on resident x (the functional layer_norm_backward recomputes as before).

neural:layernorm.route: tools/bench_board_algos.py _build_layer generic layer path (LANES layernorm ours=('LayerNorm', ...)) -> layer.to_device(x) -> python/mojolearn/_x_sequence_norm.py LayerNorm.forward/backward -> _run_dev -> bindings/_mojolearn_x_sequence.mojo layer_norm_dev -> sequence/layernorm_dev.mojo -> sequence/pyapi.mojo layer_norm_fwd_core / layer_norm_bwd_core -> sequence/exec_device.mojo DeviceExec.launch[OP_LN_FWD|OP_LN_BWD_X] (coop_kernel, SEQ_LN_COOP) -> sequence/coop.mojo coop_ln_fwd_rw / coop_ln_bwd_x_rw when ln_row_warp, else coop_ln_fwd / coop_ln_bwd_x
